_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: ✨ Suggested merges now opens as a PANEL docked on the RIGHT, not a centered pop-up — so the course list stays visible beside it AND the panel re-filters LIVE as you change the table's filters (discipline, subject, credit…). Drag its LEFT edge to resize, click » to collapse it to a thin rail (click the rail to re-open), ✕ to close. The 'Match the CCR table filters' checkbox in the panel turns the live link off if you'd rather it stay put. Your width + collapsed choice are remembered per browser. Take it for a spin and tell me if the default width / side feel right.

The per-row ⚇ Merge popup and the ✨ worklist now use the SAME editor — so everything you learned in one works in the other: the surviving course is the in-row ★ (click '☆ set as target' to pick a different survivor), plus completion notes, level chips, ⓘ descriptions, ➕ add-more-by-keyword, and ⌕ merge-into-a-different-course. Re-discipline-on-merge still works on both. If anything feels different between the two, flag it — they should match now.
